draft: true   -> the entry is NOT rendered on the site (use for work whose title or
author list is not final yet). The build prints a reminder for each one.
todo:         -> a private note for you. It is never rendered on the page.
title.url     -> optional; when present the title becomes a link.
links[]       -> small inline text links, e.g. [Paper] [Code] [Demo]. Omit when no real URL exists.
Ordering on the page follows the order of the arrays below.
